Lemma
[Distance-like exhaustion with uniform derivatives] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0309 1. ch15:15.22\group Noncompact Harnack Argument

If a complete noncompact Ricci flow on $[0,T]$ satisfies $|\Rm |+| abla \Ric |\le k_0$, then for each $O\in \mathcal M$ there is a smooth $h$ and $C=C(n,k_0,T)$ such that \[ d_{g(t)}(O,x)+1\le h(x)\le C(d_{g(t)}(O,x)+1), \quad | abla h|+| abla ^2h|\le C. \]
Proof

\sketch Choose a distance-like function with bounded first and second derivatives for $g(0)$. The curvature bound makes all $g(t)$ uniformly equivalent on $[0,T]$. Moreover $\partial _t\Gamma = abla \Ric * g^{-1}$, so the connection bound follows by integration. Rescaling $h$ absorbs the uniform constants and proves all estimates.

□
